product_wide_rationale: Governs the session landing directory across the session entry route, the session command, and the worktree workflow, so no single runtime Domain owns it.
summary: A session for selected work lands in that work's active worktree in its primary Project when the worktree is a usable directory on the machine, and in the Project canonical path otherwise; the one-directory binding, the fail-closed canonical path, and the host command as CD-0189 amended it stand, and the adapter landing guard plus the capture-launch turn stay out of scope.
title: The launcher lands in the active worktree
